patch_description: Crossover of the two programs: the current program is fast (fully vectorized snake packing) but achieves worse GPU/expert balancedness (0.66/0.25), while the inspiration program uses greedy LPT packing per-row with Python loops, achieving the same balance scores but much slower algorithm time (0.56). The new program keeps the greedy LPT heuristic (which preserves balance quality) but vectorizes it across all rows: items are sorted once, then assigned one-at-a-time in a single loop over items (not a nested Python loop), with the argmin-over-packs selection done as a batched tensor operation over all layers simultaneously, using masking of full packs. This yields near-greedy balance with only n tensor ops instead of O(n*m*layers) Python-level operations. `replicate_experts` and the hierarchical logic remain unchanged (already vectorized).
